content.text:
Catalog search now ignores accents, so `garcia marquez` finds García Márquez, and the reverse works too. All 60 tests pass, including a new one for this.

The fix is in `normaliseText` in `lib/helpers/text.js`. It now decomposes the text and strips the accent marks before lower-casing. The query, titles and authors all go through it. The only caller is `searchCatalog`, so nothing else changes.

The new test in `test/catalog.test.js` covers an accented query against an unaccented record and the other way round. It also checks `anos soledad` and `AÑOS` against "Cien años de soledad".

This only strips marks that decompose. Letters like ø, ł and đ aren't accents in Unicode, so `Soren` still won't find `Søren`. I left that out of scope.

I haven't committed anything.
